author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
This KaneAI tutorial shows you how to test your entire app in plain English, from generating test cases to auto-healing when your UI changes.
🧪 Try KaneAI free for 14 days ➜ https://kaneai.kevinstratvert.com 

First, you'll watch KaneAI generate five complete test scenarios from a single text prompt and run them all at once against a live website. 

Next, you'll learn how KaneAI works under the hood, including the difference between Quick Author for one-off tests and Scenario Generation for testing entire workflows from a requirements document. 

Then, you'll discover how to test your own localhost app by connecting a LambdaTest Tunnel so KaneAI can reach the code running on your computer. 

Along the way, you'll create a real test using both manual clicks and natural language commands in the same session, covering a LinkBio app built with Claude Code.

title: KaneAI Tutorial - Test Your Entire App in Plain English
